channel.title: US Top News and Analysis

item.title: Nasdaq futures fall after Anthropic fails to lift market sentiment: Live updates
item.description: The major averages fell more than 2% each in regular trading.

item.title: Anthropic IPO takeaways: ANT debuts with $1.8 trillion market cap in landmark moment for AI
item.description: Anthropic IPO live updates: Follow ANT stock's Nasdaq debut, opening share price, valuation and investor reaction to the Claude AI maker.

item.title: SoftBank suffers worst day in over two years as AI sell-off hits Asian tech stocks
item.description: The declines in Asia come after the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite fell more than 2% overnight following Anthropic's highly anticipated Wall Street debut.

item.title: Senate passes BAAJA permitting reform bill backed by AI, energy sectors
item.description: The permitting bill's Senate passage is a key step to it becoming law, but it would also need to clear the House before heading to President Trump's desk.

item.title: Forget Anthropic: In Europe, the IPO hype is about a blue lagoon
item.description: Iceland’s famed Blue Lagoon geothermal spa is going public in a $110 million IPO, tapping investor interest in tourism and the booming wellness industry.

item.title: AMD dives on short seller report of alleged China exposure
item.description: AMD closed down over 7% after a short seller alleged that its firmware showed up at a blacklisted Chinese company. AMD said it complies with U.S. law.

item.title: AI is changing software engineering — and some developers miss the struggle
item.description: AI coding tools are making software engineers faster, but developers tell CNBC the work has lost its "sense of joy and fun."

item.title: U.K.-India trade deal faces a stiff test over Scotch whisky import taxes
item.description: In the global spirits markets, while the U.S., Europe, and China are facing volume contraction, India will add nearly 100 million consumers in the next five years.

item.title: Anthropic was supposed to save the AI trade. What went wrong?
item.description: Technology stocks tanked despite one of the most hotly anticipated tech IPOs in years. Why Anthropic couldn't revive AI animal spirits.

item.title: Walmart hikes outlook as CEO tells CNBC retailer aims to keep prices low despite soaring fuel costs
item.description: Walmart said it saw strength with store-fulfilled pickup and delivery in its fiscal third quarter.

item.title: ‘More than just a game’: How GTA VI’s blockbuster launch fuels a booming content economy
item.description: GTA VI’s blockbuster launch is creating a wider economy around livestreams, social clips and high-volume content farms as millions tune in to watch others play.

item.title: Jensen Huang's — and Nvidia's — legal exposure balloons
item.description: "It's not going to get any better for Jensen Huang; it's going to get far worse," said Salvatore Graziano, a New York securities litigation attorney.

item.title: APEC final day in photos: Trump, Xi and Putin shake hands; Takaichi kept at a distance
item.description: Leaders gathered Thursday for the second day of the economic summit, ahead of a historic trilateral meeting between the U.S., Russia and China.

item.title: California attorney general issues Nvidia subpoena in probe of China chip diversion
item.description: The investigation by California Attorney General Rob Bonta comes on the heels of the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

item.title: Don’t buy Anthropic right away. Wait for a discount

item.title: Commerce approved sales of more than 879,000 AI chips to Chinese companies, Rep. Mast says
item.description: Members of Congress have pushed in the wake of the Jensen Huang scandal for legislation to tighten export controls on chip sales to China.

item.title: Japan core inflation soars to highest this year as energy subsidy expiry pushes up consumer prices
item.description: The core inflation figure — which strips out prices of food — was lower than the 2.3% expected by Reuters-polled economists.

item.title: Congress passes bill to protect older investors from financial fraud
item.description: Both chambers of Congress have now approved the Financial Exploitation Prevention Act of 2025, which is aimed at protecting vulnerable investors from fraud.

item.title: One of the world's most contested seas is proving too much for Asia's leaders to resolve
item.description: The ASEAN summit in the Philippines failed to conclude the Code of Conduct for the South China Sea despite Manila pledging it would happen this year.

item.title: Intuit to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion
item.description: Intuit is offloading a segment that has slowed down revenue growth, for less than a third of what it paid to acquire Mailchimp in 2021.

item.title: Booking a Hilton stay? Stack a 20% discount, 5,000 bonus points and up to 200,000 points in card bonus offers
item.description: New Amex Hilton card members may have instant access to their card number, which makes it easier to take advantage of these promotions.

item.title: Trump bought Nvidia, Palantir, SpaceX in September as federal deals, White House ties grew
item.description: President Trump disclosed purchases of Nvidia stock, SpaceX debt and Tesla shares in September, alongside millions of dollars in other investments.

item.title: Amazon app warns New York of higher costs if Mamdani delivery law passes

item.title: Amid recent banking outages, should you start carrying cash again? Top advisors weigh in

item.title: Inside India newsletter: Foreign flows helped the market recover. Now it faces the inflation test

item.title: Kraken parent's acquisition of Tribe Capital flags new chapter in evolution of crypto exchanges
